prompt_recommendations.title: Force a non-empty visible reply on every tutor turn
prompt_recommendations.rationale: The transcript shows no tutor content at all, suggesting the model may have emitted only tool calls or empty text. The system prompt should mandate visible text accompanying any tool call.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: Begin the lesson. Greet the student briefly, name what they'll learn in one short sentence, then immediately pose the first warm-up question via pose_question — include the full question stem
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: HARD RULE: Every tutor turn MUST contain visible natural-language text for the student. If you call a tool (e.g., pose_question), you must ALSO include the full question stem and any options in your visible reply. Never emit a turn with empty or tool-only content.
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Eliminates blank tutor turns and guarantees the student always sees the question or feedback.

prompt_recommendations.title: Specify recovery behavior after a failed/empty turn
prompt_recommendations.rationale: Student turn 6 ('no problem! let's try again') implies the previous tutor attempt failed. The prompt should instruct the tutor how to recover: re-pose the intended question cleanly, not defer.

prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit: If the previous turn failed or the student signals a restart ('let's try again', 'retry'), immediately re-issue the intended warm-up question in full visible text, without apology loops or meta-discussion.
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Ensures graceful recovery from tool/format failures and preserves lesson momentum.

prompt_recommendations.title: Concrete opening template with example
prompt_recommendations.rationale: The user instruction was detailed but abstract; providing a filled example in the system prompt reduces the chance of format failure on the very first turn.
prompt_recommendations.evidence_quote: Greet the student briefly, name what they'll learn in one short sentence, then immediately pose the first warm-up question
prompt_recommendations.suggested_prompt_edit:
OPENING TEMPLATE (use verbatim structure):
'Hi! Today we'll practise <topic in one sentence>.

Q1: <full stem>
A) ... B) ... C) ... D) ...'
Then call pose_question with matching arguments.
prompt_recommendations.expected_effect: Reduces malformed openings; ensures the student sees a complete question on turn 1.
